description:
A ChatTurns document: one user message and the reply to it, with the
tool steps in between. Replayed whole as the history of the next turns,
so every tool_calls message is followed by its tool messages, as Meta
requires. Saved only once the turn succeeded. (conversationId, seq) is
unique (mongoDb.ensureIndexes).

userId.description: The Users or Customers _id it belongs to
userId.title: Userid

userText.description: What the user sent ("" when only files were)
userText.title: Usertext

userContent.description: What the model read for the user's turn, when it is more than userText: a form answer's summary and details
userContent.title: Usercontent

attachments.description: The files the user sent with it (none on a turn stored before attachments)
attachments.title: Attachments

components.description: The cards and forms shown under the reply, as sent
components.title: Components

formAnswer.description: The form answer this turn sent, when it is one: userText is then its summary
formAnswer.title: Formanswer
